officialSources.officialDescriptionSummary: Official HÖ8 sources describe a medium-difficulty stage from Lemnhult to Lindshammar through Stora och Lilla Fly, with pine mires, a wilderness character and seasonal berries such as blueberries and cloudberries. Official facility context centers on Stora och Lilla Fly, where the route has a shelter, fireplace and dry toilet near the reserve parking area. Lindshammar is described as an endpoint with bus connection and nearby restaurant/B&B services.
officialSources.appDetailTextDraft: This medium stage leaves Lemnhult and heads southwest to Lindshammar, crossing the mire and pine-forest landscape around Stora och Lilla Fly. The strongest on-route rest cluster is at Stora Fly, where coordinate-backed official records place a shelter, fireplace, dry toilet, parking/access point, picnic table and reserve information close to the route. The route has no confirmed public drinking-water point, and the mire boardwalks around Stora och Lilla Fly should be treated as slippery in wet, humid or icy conditions. Public transport is weak at Lemnhult, with the nearest fixed-route stops several kilometers away, while Lindshammar has a bus stop close to the endpoint.

protectedAreas.name: Stora och Lilla Fly naturreservat
rulesSummary: Do not damage natural objects, trees or bushes.
Do not collect mosses, lichens or fungi other than edible mushrooms.
Do not collect invertebrates or disturb wildlife and nest trees.
Do not cycle or ride in the reserve.
Do not drive motor vehicles except limited moose-retrieval exceptions.
Do not set up motor vehicles, caravans or trailers.
Do not put up signs or hold organized competitions/exercise activities.

researchIterations.mainThreadSynthesis: The first six-lane batch was sufficient for research handoff. Official GPX/API geometry is navigation-grade, section endpoints are continuous with HÖ7/HÖ9, core facilities at Stora Fly have coordinate-backed official records, and the main import caveats are explicit: weak Lemnhult access, no public potable water, Stora och Lilla Fly reserve scoping/camping wording, Stora Fly toilet/parking wording, and stale legacy Lemnhult-Lökarydssjön sources.

openQuestions: Run GIS overlay to scope exactly where HÖ8 crosses Stora och Lilla Fly and whether any Helvetets håla boundary intersects the main route.
Check the legal decision/PDF or posted signs for Stora och Lilla Fly before final camping wording; the visitor page did not explicitly ban ordinary tenting.
Field-check Stora/Lilla Fly boardwalk condition, post-Storm-Dave windthrow, shelter condition and dry-toilet availability before high-confidence trip guidance.
Deduplicate Stora Fly parking/toilet/picnic/info records and resolve the toilet-distance wording conflict.
Deduplicate Lindshammar ledentré HÖ8/HÖ9 and Lindshammar ledstart before import.
Verify whether Stora Fly parking should be imported as a public facility or only kept as access metadata because of record freshness/capacity uncertainty.
Recheck JLT line 352 and 345 timetables after the 2025-08-11 to 2026-06-14 period.
Do not attach Jättabacken facilities to HÖ8 as core facilities unless deliberate shared endpoint modeling is desired.
Do not infer drinking water from Stora Fly facilities, bog/lake water, Boskvarnasjön bathing water or Sergel customer services.
